theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_efp_unimodular_eigenrow_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (k r s : R), (∃ x y : R, x * r + y * s = 1) → ((∃ u : Rˣ, s = (u : R) * r ∧ k * s - r = (u : R) * s) ↔ IsUnit r ∧ ∃! t : R, s = r * t ∧ t ^ 2 - k * t + 1 = 0)
